extraMeanings.en: to affect someone very strongly, especially with emotion
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She was overcome with grief when she heard the news.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Haberi duyduğunda kederden yıkıldı.

extraMeanings.en: suddenly, in a very short time
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The song became a hit overnight.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şarkı bir anda hit oldu.

extraMeanings.en: extra time added to a game when the score is tied
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The game went into overtime after a last-minute goal.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Son dakika golüyle maç uzatmaya gitti.

extraMeanings.tr: minnettar olmak, (bir şeyi birine) borçlu olmak (sayesinde sahip olmak)
extraMeanings.en: to feel that you should do something for someone because they helped you
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I owe my success to my parents.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Başarımı ailem sayesinde elde ettim / başarımı aileme borçluyum.

extraMeanings.tr: volta atmak, bir aşağı bir yukarı yürümek (fiil)
extraMeanings.en: to walk back and forth, especially because you are worried
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He paced up and down the room, waiting for the phone to ring.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Telefonun çalmasını bekleyerek odada bir aşağı bir yukarı volta attı.

extraMeanings.en: a tropical tree with large leaves and no branches
extraMeanings.exampleEn: We relaxed under the palm trees on the beach.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Plajda palmiye ağaçlarının altında dinlendik.

extraMeanings.en: a similarity between two things
extraMeanings.exampleEn: There are interesting parallels between the two events.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İki olay arasında ilginç benzerlikler var.

extraMeanings.en: favoring one side; having a strong liking for something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: A good judge must not be partial to either side.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İyi bir hakim taraflardan hiçbirine taraflı olmamalıdır.

extraMeanings.en: something you feel very enthusiastic about
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Cooking is her greatest passion.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yemek pişirmek onun en büyük tutkusudur.

extraMeanings.en: the time before the present
extraMeanings.exampleEn: We should learn from the past.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Geçmişten ders almalıyız.

extraMeanings.en: beyond in position or time; up to and further than
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The bus went past the station without stopping.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Otobüs durmadan istasyonun önünden geçip gitti.

extraMeanings.en: a person who is receiving medical treatment
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The doctor examined the patient carefully.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Doktor hastayı dikkatlice muayene etti.

extraMeanings.en: a shape used as a guide for making something, e.g. clothes
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She used a paper pattern to cut out the dress.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Elbiseyi kesmek için kağıt bir kalıp kullandı.

extraMeanings.en: to stop doing something for a short time
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She paused for a moment before answering.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Cevap vermeden önce bir an duraksadı.

extraMeanings.en: a quick look at something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She took a peek at the presents under the tree.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ağacın altındaki hediyelere gizlice bir göz attı.

extraMeanings.en: to choose someone or something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Please pick a card from the deck.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Lütfen desteden bir kart seç.

extraMeanings.en: to remove a flower or fruit from a plant
extraMeanings.exampleEn: We picked apples in the orchard.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bahçede elma topladık.

extraMeanings.en: a small amount of something you can hold between finger and thumb
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Add a pinch of salt to the soup.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çorbaya bir tutam tuz ekle.

extraMeanings.en: a tube with a small bowl at one end for smoking tobacco
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The old man smoked a pipe by the fire.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yaşlı adam şöminenin yanında pipo içiyordu.

extraMeanings.en: the hard seed in the middle of some fruits
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Be careful of the pit when you eat the cherry.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kirazı yerken çekirdeğine dikkat et.

extraMeanings.en: easy to understand or see; clear
extraMeanings.exampleEn: It's plain that she is unhappy.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Mutsuz olduğu apaçık ortada.

extraMeanings.en: a large area of flat land
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Herds of animals roam across the plains.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Hayvan sürüleri ovalarda dolaşıyor.

extraMeanings.en: a round object used to block the hole in a sink or bath
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She pulled out the plug and let the water drain.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Tıpayı çekti ve suyun boşalmasını sağladı.

extraMeanings.en: to connect to electricity, or to fill/block a hole
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Plug the charger into the wall socket.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şarj aletini duvardaki prize tak.

extraMeanings.en: to ask people questions to find out their opinions
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Researchers polled 1,000 voters before the election.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Araştırmacılar seçimden önce 1.000 seçmene anket yaptı.

extraMeanings.en: one of the two points at the top and bottom of the Earth
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Explorers reached the North Pole after a long journey.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kaşifler uzun bir yolculuğun ardından Kuzey Kutbu'na ulaştı.

extraMeanings.en: a socket on a computer or device for connecting equipment
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Plug the cable into the USB port.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kabloyu USB portuna tak.

extraMeanings.en: a person who is in charge of the entrance of a hotel or building
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The porter greeted us as we entered the hotel.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Otele girerken kapı görevlisi bizi karşıladı.

extraMeanings.en: completely sure about something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Are you positive that you locked the door?
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kapıyı kilitlediğinden emin misin?

extraMeanings.en: showing that a substance or condition is present in a test
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Her test came back positive.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Testi pozitif çıktı.

extraMeanings.en: a container for growing plants
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She planted the flowers in a large pot.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çiçekleri büyük bir saksıya dikti.

extraMeanings.tr: küt küt atmak, güm güm vurmak (fiil)
extraMeanings.en: to hit something hard many times, or (of the heart) to beat strongly
extraMeanings.exampleEn: My heart was pounding as I opened the letter.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Mektubu açarken kalbim küt küt atıyordu.

extraMeanings.en: soft fresh snow
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The skiers loved the fresh powder on the mountain.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kayakçılar dağdaki taze kar tozunu çok sevdi.

extraMeanings.en: relating to real experience and action rather than theory
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The course includes both theory and practical work.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ders hem teori hem de uygulamalı çalışma içeriyor.

extraMeanings.en: an official document that allows you to do something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: You need a permit to park here.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Buraya park etmek için bir izin belgesine ihtiyacın var.

extraMeanings.en: to influence someone unfairly so they have an unreasonable opinion
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The negative reports may prejudice the jury against him.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Olumsuz haberler jüriyi ona karşı önyargıya sürükleyebilir.
